onscreen_lines.desc: Trade: 10 2980- Window Vinyl DBL HNG DBL GLZ Address 4 windows serving the main house. Windows are in poor working condition. The windows will not operate safely. onscreen_lines.desc: Trade: 15 4585-Reroof 7/16" Deck/Shingle Address sagging roof. Ridge board sags between eaves and center both directions of single peak roof. Address structural support. Repairs may include sistering rafters, using jack supports, installing ties and bracing. Remove roof to deck. Complete structural repairs. Install 7/16" OSB over entire roof. Install 15 lb. felt. Ice and damn shield where required, self-self-sealing, laminated architectural shingle. Replace all flashing, including valleys and roof edge. Flash and counter flash chimneys. Kick out flashing where flashing terminates at side walls. Ice and dam underlayment as required by current ICC code. Venting as required by ICC code. Install shingle-over ridge vent. Clean and dispose of all exterior debris generated by the tear off and replacement of the roof. All work is to be completed to current International Residential Building Code. Color choice selected by owner of in stock colors.
